WITH sat_excellence AS (
  SELECT cds AS school_id,
         CAST(SUM(NumGE1500) AS FLOAT) / SUM(NumTstTakr) AS sat_excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
  HAVING sat_excellence_rate > 0.3
)
SELECT MAX(frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN sat_excellence ON frpm.CDSCode = sat_excellence.school_id;

  SELECT cds,
         CAST(NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(NumTstTakr, 0) AS SAT_Excellence_Rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumTstTakr > 0
), EligibleRates AS (
  SELECT CDSCode,
         "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" AS FreeMeal_Eligibility_Rate_5_17
  FROM frpm
)

WITH charter_sandiego_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE CharterNum = 756
  AND LOWER(MailCity) = 'san diego'
), sat_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode AS school_id,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT MAX(ss.NumTstTakr)
      FROM satscores ss
      WHERE ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    ), 0) AS test_takers
  FROM charter_sandiego_schools s
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(test_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM sat_counts;

WITH district_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, GSoffered AS grade_span
    FROM schools
    WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
      AND ClosedDate IS NULL
      AND GSoffered LIKE '%12%'
),
sat_counts AS (
    SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS test_takers
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM district_schools)
    GROUP BY cds
),
zero_sat_schools AS (
    SELECT d.CDSCode, d.School, d.grade_span
    FROM district_schools d
    LEFT JOIN sat_counts s ON d.CDSCode = s.cds
    WHERE (s.test_takers IS NULL OR s.test_takers = 0)
),
grade_order AS (
    SELECT 'Preschool' AS grade_name, 1 AS grade_num UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Kindergarten', 2 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 1', 3 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 2', 4 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 3', 5 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 4', 6 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 5', 7 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 6', 8 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 7', 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 8', 10 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 9', 11 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 10', 12 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 11', 13 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Grade 12', 14
),
parse_start_grade AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, School, grade_span,
      CASE
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Preschool-%' THEN 'Preschool'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Kindergarten-%' THEN 'Kindergarten'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 1-%' THEN 'Grade 1'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 2-%' THEN 'Grade 2'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 3-%' THEN 'Grade 3'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 4-%' THEN 'Grade 4'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 5-%' THEN 'Grade 5'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 6-%' THEN 'Grade 6'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 7-%' THEN 'Grade 7'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 8-%' THEN 'Grade 8'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 9-%' THEN 'Grade 9'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 10-%' THEN 'Grade 10'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 11-%' THEN 'Grade 11'
        WHEN grade_span LIKE 'Grade 12-%' THEN 'Grade 12'
        ELSE NULL
      END AS start_grade
    FROM zero_sat_schools
),
start_grade_num AS (
    SELECT p.CDSCode, p.School, p.start_grade, g.grade_num, p.grade_span
    FROM parse_start_grade p
    LEFT JOIN grade_order g ON p.start_grade = g.grade_name
),
min_grade AS (
    SELECT MIN(grade_num) AS min_grade_num FROM start_grade_num
)
SELECT School, grade_span
FROM start_grade_num, min_grade
WHERE grade_num = min_grade_num
ORDER BY School ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH DirectlyRunSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, MailStreet, MailCity, MailState, MailZip
  FROM schools
  WHERE EdOpsName = 'State Board of Education' AND MailState = 'CA'
),
SchoolReadingScores AS (
  SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cds
),
MaxScore AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_reading_score) AS max_score
  FROM SchoolReadingScores sr
  JOIN DirectlyRunSchools ds ON sr.cds = ds.CDSCode
)
SELECT ds.School AS name,
       ds.MailStreet || ', ' || ds.MailCity || ', ' || ds.MailState || ' ' || ds.MailZip AS mailing_street_address
FROM DirectlyRunSchools ds
JOIN SchoolReadingScores sr ON ds.CDSCode = sr.cds
JOIN MaxScore m ON sr.avg_reading_score = m.max_score;

qualified_scores AS (

FROM cde_schools s

WITH GradeRank AS (
  SELECT 'P' AS grade, 1 AS rank UNION ALL
  SELECT 'K', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 7 UNION ALL

  SELECT '7', 9 UNION ALL

-- Identify candidate schools with special needs related names
 CandidateSchools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSoffered,
    s.GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN s.GSoffered IS NULL THEN 'K'  -- assume K if no data
      ELSE substr(s.GSoffered, 1, 1)
    END AS start_grade_code
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND (
    lower(s.School) LIKE '%deaf%' OR
    lower(s.School) LIKE '%blind%' OR
    lower(s.School) LIKE '%special%'
  )
),
GradeRanks AS (
  SELECT cs.*, gr.rank AS start_rank
  FROM CandidateSchools cs
  LEFT JOIN GradeRank gr ON cs.start_grade_code = gr.grade
),
SATCounts AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS SATtesters
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'overall'
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT 
  gr.School,
  gr.start_grade_code AS EarliestGradeLevel,
  gr.GSserved AS K12Enrollment,
  COALESCE(s.SATtesters, 0) AS SATTestTakers
FROM GradeRanks gr
LEFT JOIN SATCounts s ON gr.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY gr.start_rank DESC, gr.GSserved DESC, gr.School ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH StateSpecialSchools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode, "School Name"
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
      AND "School Type" = 'State Special'
      AND "School Name" IS NOT NULL
      AND "School Name" != ''
),
EarliestGradeNum AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, "School Name" AS School, 
      CASE 
        WHEN "Low Grade" = 'P' THEN 0
        WHEN "Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 1
        ELSE CAST("Low Grade" AS INTEGER)
      END AS EarliestGradeNum,
      "Enrollment (K-12)"
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-15'
      AND CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM StateSpecialSchools)
),
SATCounts AS (
    SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S' AND cds IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM StateSpecialSchools)
    GROUP BY cds
),
SchoolData AS (
    SELECT eg.CDSCode, eg.School, eg.EarliestGradeNum, eg."Enrollment (K-12)", COALESCE(sc.NumTstTakr, 0) AS SATTestTakers
    FROM EarliestGradeNum eg
    LEFT JOIN SATCounts sc ON eg.CDSCode = sc.cds
)
SELECT School, 
    CASE 
      WHEN EarliestGradeNum = 0 THEN 'P'
      WHEN EarliestGradeNum = 1 THEN 'K'
      ELSE CAST(EarliestGradeNum AS TEXT)
    END AS EarliestGrade,
    "Enrollment (K-12)" AS K12Enrollment,
    SATTestTakers
FROM SchoolData
ORDER BY EarliestGradeNum DESC, "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC, School
LIMIT 1;

WITH ActiveCharterCountySchools AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, f.[Charter Funding Type] AS FundingType
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.DOCType = 'County'
    AND f.[Charter Funding Type] IN ('directly funded', 'locally funded')
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode, f.[Charter Funding Type]
),
EnrollmentFRPM AS (
  SELECT FundingType,
         COUNT(DISTINCT a.CDSCode) AS OperatingSchools,
         SUM(f.[Enrollment (K-12)]) AS TotalEnrollmentK12,
         SUM(f.[FRPM Count (K-12)]) AS TotalFRPMEligibleK12
  FROM ActiveCharterCountySchools a
  JOIN frpm f ON a.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    AND a.FundingType = f.[Charter Funding Type]
  GROUP BY FundingType
)
SELECT FundingType,
       OperatingSchools AS CurrentlyOperatingSchools,
       TotalEnrollmentK12 AS TotalK12Enrollment,
       TotalFRPMEligibleK12 AS TotalFRPMEligibleK12Students
FROM EnrollmentFRPM
ORDER BY CASE FundingType WHEN 'directly funded' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

    SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS counterparty_count
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'transfer'
      AND t.bank != a.district_id
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),

    JOIN OwnerDistricts od ON bh.account_id = od.account_id

    r.account_id AS account_number,

WITH FemaleLoans AS (
    SELECT L.loan_id, L.account_id, L.amount, L.duration, L.payments, L.status, C.client_id, C.birth_date
    FROM loan L
    JOIN client C ON L.account_id = C.client_id
    WHERE C.gender = 'F'
),
MaxLoanAmount AS (
    SELECT amount
    FROM FemaleLoans
    ORDER BY amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
TopLoans AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM FemaleLoans
    WHERE amount >= (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM MaxLoanAmount)
),
AccountDistrictRegion AS (
    SELECT A.account_id, A.district_id, D.A7 AS region
    FROM account A
    JOIN district D ON A.district_id = D.district_id
),
LoanInfo AS (
    SELECT TL.*, ADR.district_id, ADR.region
    FROM TopLoans TL
    JOIN AccountDistrictRegion ADR ON TL.account_id = ADR.account_id
),
TransactionsSummary AS (
    SELECT T.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN T.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN T.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans T
    GROUP BY T.account_id
),
RegionLoanCounts AS (
    SELECT ADR.region, COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
    FROM loan L
    JOIN account A ON L.account_id = A.account_id
    JOIN district D ON A.district_id = D.district_id
    JOIN AccountDistrictRegion ADR ON A.account_id = ADR.account_id
    GROUP BY ADR.region
),
RegionAvgSalaries AS (
    SELECT A7 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A13), 2) AS region_avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A7
),
ClientAges AS (
    SELECT C.client_id, C.birth_date,
           (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', C.birth_date) -
           (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', C.birth_date))) AS age
    FROM client C
)
SELECT
    LI.client_id,
    ROUND(LI.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
    LI.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(LI.payments * LI.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(LI.payments * LI.duration - LI.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    LI.status AS loan_status,
    LI.district_id,
    LI.region,
    COALESCE(TS.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(TS.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(TS.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * LI.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(TS.total_deposits, 0) > LI.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    COALESCE(RLC.loans_in_region, 0) AS loans_in_region,
    COALESCE(RAS.region_avg_salary, 0) AS avg_salary_region,
    CA.age AS completed_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM LoanInfo LI
LEFT JOIN TransactionsSummary TS ON LI.account_id = TS.account_id
LEFT JOIN RegionLoanCounts RLC ON LI.region = RLC.region
LEFT JOIN RegionAvgSalaries RAS ON LI.region = RAS.region
LEFT JOIN ClientAges CA ON LI.client_id = CA.client_id
ORDER BY LI.amount DESC, LI.client_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH FemaleLoans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    c.client_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.amount AS approved_amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments AS monthly_payment,
    l.status,
    a.district_id AS branch_district_id,
    d.A7 AS region,
    c.birth_date
  FROM loan l
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = l.account_id AND dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
TopLoanThreshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(approved_amount) AS min_top_amount
  FROM (
    SELECT approved_amount
    FROM FemaleLoans
    GROUP BY approved_amount
    ORDER BY approved_amount DESC
    LIMIT 3
  )
),
TopFemaleLoans AS (
  SELECT * FROM FemaleLoans
  WHERE approved_amount >= (SELECT min_top_amount FROM TopLoanThreshold)
),
LoanPayments AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(monthly_payment * duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(monthly_payment * duration - approved_amount, 2) AS interest_paid
  FROM TopFemaleLoans
),
AccountTransStats AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
IncomeCat AS (
  SELECT
    tfl.loan_id,
    CASE
      WHEN ats.total_deposits > 2 * tfl.approved_amount THEN 'High Income'
      WHEN ats.total_deposits > tfl.approved_amount THEN 'Medium Income'
      ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category
  FROM TopFemaleLoans tfl
  LEFT JOIN AccountTransStats ats ON ats.account_id = tfl.account_id
),
RegionLoanCount AS (
  SELECT
    d.A7 AS region,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loans_in_region
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A7
),
RegionAvgSalary AS (
  SELECT
    A7 AS region,
    ROUND(AVG(A13), 2) AS avg_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY A7
),
ClientsAge AS (
  SELECT
    client_id,
    birth_date,
    (strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) -
    CASE
      WHEN strftime('%m%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m%d', birth_date) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS age_completed_2026_10_09
  FROM client
),
BranchDistrictRegion AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id AS branch_district_id,
    d.A7 AS region
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
),
FinalResult AS (
  SELECT
    tfl.client_id,
    tfl.approved_amount AS loan_amount,
    tfl.duration,
    lp.total_payments,
    lp.interest_paid,
    tfl.status AS loan_status,
    bd.branch_district_id AS branch_district,
    bd.region,
    COALESCE(ats.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count,
    COALESCE(ats.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
    ic.income_category,
    rlc.loans_in_region,
    ras.avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
    ca.age_completed_2026_10_09 AS client_age_on_2026_10_09
  FROM TopFemaleLoans tfl
  JOIN LoanPayments lp ON lp.loan_id = tfl.loan_id
  JOIN BranchDistrictRegion bd ON bd.account_id = tfl.account_id
  LEFT JOIN AccountTransStats ats ON ats.account_id = tfl.account_id
  LEFT JOIN IncomeCat ic ON ic.loan_id = tfl.loan_id
  LEFT JOIN RegionLoanCount rlc ON rlc.region = bd.region
  LEFT JOIN RegionAvgSalary ras ON ras.region = bd.region
  JOIN ClientsAge ca ON ca.client_id = tfl.client_id
)
SELECT 
  client_id,
  ROUND(loan_amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
  duration,
  total_payments,
  interest_paid,
  loan_status,
  branch_district,
  region,
  trans_count,
  ROUND(total_deposits, 2) AS total_deposits,
  income_category,
  loans_in_region,
  region_avg_salary,
  client_age_on_2026_10_09
FROM FinalResult
ORDER BY loan_amount DESC, client_id
;

WITH districts_qualified AS (
    SELECT district_id, A8 AS population, A10 AS avg_salary
    FROM district
    WHERE A8 >= 100000
),
accounts_1997 AS (
    SELECT account_id, district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND date < '1998-01-01'
      AND frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
),
qualified_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM accounts_1997 a
    INNER JOIN districts_qualified dq ON a.district_id = dq.district_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(qualified_accounts.account_id) AS total_monthly_statement_accounts,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qualified_accounts.district_id) AS number_of_districts,
    ROUND(AVG(dq.avg_salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualified_accounts
INNER JOIN districts_qualified dq ON qualified_accounts.district_id = dq.district_id;

WITH GoldAccounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT disp.account_id
    FROM disp
    JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
    WHERE card.type = 'gold'
),
BranchInfo AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS district_name, d.A2 AS region
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM GoldAccounts)
),
AmountSums AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM GoldAccounts)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
LoanCounts AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loans_taken
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM GoldAccounts)
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
AccountBank AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id, bank
    FROM trans
),
ExternalCounterparties AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS ext_counterparty_count
    FROM trans t
    JOIN AccountBank ab ON t.account = ab.account_id
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM GoldAccounts)
    AND ab.bank != (SELECT bank FROM trans WHERE account_id = t.account_id LIMIT 1) -- external banks
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
Ranks AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        bi.district_name,
        bi.region,
        COALESCE(am.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
        COALESCE(am.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.loans_taken, 0) AS loans_taken,
        COALESCE(ec.ext_counterparty_count, 0) AS ext_counterparty_count
    FROM GoldAccounts a
    LEFT JOIN BranchInfo bi ON a.account_id = bi.account_id
    LEFT JOIN AmountSums am ON a.account_id = am.account_id
    LEFT JOIN LoanCounts lc ON a.account_id = lc.account_id
    LEFT JOIN ExternalCounterparties ec ON a.account_id = ec.account_id
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ext_counterparty_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM Ranks
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, loans_taken, ext_counterparty_count, rank
FROM Ranked
ORDER BY rank, account_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH GoldAccounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
AccountDistrict AS (
  SELECT district_id, A4 AS district_name, A6 AS region
  FROM district
),
TransSummary AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_amount_withdrawn
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
LoanCount AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
ExternalCounterparty AS (
  SELECT 
    account_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS external_counterparty_count
  FROM trans
  WHERE bank IS NOT NULL AND bank != (SELECT bank FROM district WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM account WHERE account_id = account_id LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1)
  GROUP BY account_id
)

SELECT
  ga.account_id,
  ad.district_name,
  ad.region,
  COALESCE(ts.total_amount_received, 0) AS total_amount_received,
  COALESCE(ts.total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS total_amount_withdrawn,
  COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
  COALESCE(ec.external_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ec.external_counterparty_count, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM GoldAccounts ga
LEFT JOIN AccountDistrict ad ON ga.district_id = ad.district_id
LEFT JOIN TransSummary ts ON ga.account_id = ts.account_id
LEFT JOIN LoanCount lc ON ga.account_id = lc.account_id
LEFT JOIN ExternalCounterparty ec ON ga.account_id = ec.account_id
ORDER BY external_counterparty_count DESC, ga.account_id;

WITH TaborDistrict AS (
  SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A4 = 'Tabor'
),

AccountOwner AS (
  SELECT d.account_id, c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, a.date AS opening_date
  FROM disp d
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM TaborDistrict)
),

CardsPerAccount AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(card.card_id) AS card_count
  FROM card
  JOIN disp d ON card.disp_id = d.disp_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE card.issued <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY a.account_id
),

LoansPerAccount AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(loan_id) AS loan_count,
         MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_defaulted,
         MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),

Transactions1997 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
         MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),

LoanStanding AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         CASE
           WHEN loan_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN has_defaulted = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
         END AS loan_standing
  FROM LoansPerAccount
),

FinalProfiles AS (
  SELECT ao.account_id,
         ao.opening_date,
         ao.gender,
         CAST((julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(ao.birth_date)) / 365 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_1996_12_31,
         COALESCE(cp.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(lp.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         ls.loan_standing,
         COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS trans_count_1997,
         COALESCE(t.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
         COALESCE(t.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
         COALESCE(t.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
  FROM AccountOwner ao
  LEFT JOIN CardsPerAccount cp ON ao.account_id = cp.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoansPerAccount lp ON ao.account_id = lp.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoanStanding ls ON ao.account_id = ls.account_id
  LEFT JOIN Transactions1997 t ON ao.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE ao.opening_date <= '1996-12-31'
),

RankedProfiles AS (
  SELECT *,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC, account_id ASC) AS peak_balance_rank
  FROM FinalProfiles
)

SELECT account_id,
       opening_date,
       gender,
       age_at_1996_12_31,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       trans_count_1997 AS trans_count,
       money_in_1997 AS money_in,
       money_out_1997 AS money_out,
       peak_balance_1997 AS peak_balance,
       peak_balance_rank
FROM RankedProfiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH classic_card_owners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id, d.client_id, a.district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'classic'
), outgoing_payments AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.bank, t.account AS account_to, SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY t.account_id, t.bank, t.account
), external_payments AS (
    SELECT cco.district_id, cco.client_id, cco.account_id,
           op.bank, op.account_to, op.total_amount
    FROM classic_card_owners cco
    LEFT JOIN outgoing_payments op ON cco.account_id = op.account_id
    WHERE op.bank IS NOT NULL AND op.bank != 'CSOB'
), agg_by_district AS (
    SELECT d.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT cco.client_id) AS num_classic_card_clients,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ep.account_to) AS num_external_accounts,
           COALESCE(SUM(ep.total_amount), 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
    FROM district d
    LEFT JOIN classic_card_owners cco ON d.district_id = cco.district_id
    LEFT JOIN external_payments ep ON ep.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.district_id
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(a.num_classic_card_clients, 0) AS num_classic_card_clients,
       COALESCE(a.num_external_accounts, 0) AS num_external_accounts,
       COALESCE(a.total_outgoing_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN agg_by_district a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH OlderFemales AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
  FROM client c
  WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
), OlderFemaleAccounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN OlderFemales ofem ON d.client_id = ofem.client_id
), AccountsDistricts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN OlderFemaleAccounts ofa ON a.account_id = ofa.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A13), 2) AS average_salary
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM AccountsDistricts)

WITH race_2000 AS (

  FROM races

newer_2017_races AS (

WITH japanese_1995_race AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
  WHERE s.year = 1995 AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
),
qualifying_q1 AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN japanese_1995_race j ON q.raceId = j.raceId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
),
slowest_q1_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(q1) AS max_q1
  FROM qualifying_q1
),
slowest_drivers AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying_q1 q
  JOIN slowest_q1_time s ON q.q1 = s.max_q1
)
SELECT d.code AS short_reference_name, d.nationality, d.dob AS birthday, s.q1 AS Q1_time
FROM slowest_drivers s
JOIN drivers d ON s.driverId = d.driverId

WITH race_id AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1995 AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
), q1_times AS (
    SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN race_id r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
), fastest_time AS (
    SELECT MIN(q1) AS min_q1
    FROM q1_times
), fastest_drivers AS (
    SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
    FROM q1_times q
    JOIN fastest_time f ON q.q1 = f.min_q1
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, f.q1
FROM fastest_drivers f
JOIN drivers d ON f.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH season_2010 AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2010
),
lucas_qualifying AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.position AS lucas_position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN season_2010 s ON q.raceId = s.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.driverRef = 'digrass'
),
qualifying_all AS (

  FROM races r

  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL

CircuitTimeComponents AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    circuitId,

  SELECT
    year,

    circuitRef,
    CAST(hour AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(minute AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(second AS INTEGER) AS start_time_seconds
  FROM CircuitTimeComponents
),

EarliestTime AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_time_seconds) AS earliest_start_time FROM CircuitTimesInSeconds
),

LatestTime AS (
  SELECT MAX(start_time_seconds) AS latest_start_time FROM CircuitTimesInSeconds
),

EarliestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuitRef, start_time_seconds
  FROM CircuitTimesInSeconds, EarliestTime
  WHERE start_time_seconds = earliest_start_time
),

LatestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuitRef, start_time_seconds
  FROM CircuitTimesInSeconds, LatestTime
  WHERE start_time_seconds = latest_start_time
),

TimeDifferenceSeconds AS (
  SELECT (latest_start_time - earliest_start_time) AS time_gap_seconds
  FROM EarliestTime, LatestTime
)

  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') FROM EarliestCircuits) AS earliest_circuits,
  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') FROM LatestCircuits) AS latest_circuits,
  (SELECT time_gap_seconds FROM TimeDifferenceSeconds) AS gap_in_seconds
;

  SELECT h.id
  FROM superhero h
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON h.id = ha.hero_id
  JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
  JOIN gender g ON h.gender_id = g.id
  WHERE a.attribute_name IN ('God', 'Eternal')
  AND g.gender = 'Male'
),
HeroSuperPowerCounts AS (
  SELECT h.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS superpower_count
  FROM superhero h
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  GROUP BY h.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(superpower_count), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM HeroSuperPowerCounts
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM GodEternalMaleHeroes);

WITH CryokinesisHeroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE power_id = (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Cryokinesis')
),

HeroesSharingCryokinesis AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.power_id IN (
        SELECT power_id
        FROM hero_power
        WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM CryokinesisHeroes)
    )
),

CryokinesisSharedHeroesWithCount AS (
    SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS superpower_count
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM HeroesSharingCryokinesis)
    GROUP BY hp.hero_id
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(superpower_count), 1) AS average_superpowers
FROM CryokinesisSharedHeroesWithCount

WITH a_bomb_race AS (

),
group_heroes_with_height AS (

  WHERE sh.height_cm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1) AS avg_height_cm
FROM group_heroes_with_height;

WITH
  blackwulf_publisher AS (
    SELECT p.id AS publisher_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  blackwulf_publisher_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN blackwulf_publisher bp ON s.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
  ),
  other_publishers_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    WHERE s.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND s.publisher_id != (SELECT publisher_id FROM blackwulf_publisher)
      AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  common_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eye_colour_id
    FROM blackwulf_publisher_heroes
    WHERE eye_colour_id IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM other_publishers_eye_colours)
  )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS count_heroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN blackwulf_publisher bp ON s.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM common_eye_colours);

WITH PublisherOfCharlesChandler AS (
  SELECT s.publisher_id
  FROM superhero s
  WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
), PublisherSuperheroes AS (
  SELECT s.race_id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN PublisherOfCharlesChandler p ON s.publisher_id = p.publisher_id
  WHERE s.race_id IS NOT NULL
), RaceCounts AS (
  SELECT r.race AS race_name, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM PublisherSuperheroes ps
  JOIN race r ON ps.race_id = r.id
  GROUP BY ps.race_id
), MaxCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(race_count) AS max_count
  FROM RaceCounts
)
SELECT race_name, race_count
FROM RaceCounts
WHERE race_count = (SELECT max_count FROM MaxCount);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(intelligence), 1) AS average_intelligence

WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM Powers);

WITH HairAttr AS (
  SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'Hair Colour'
), EyeAttr AS (
  SELECT id FROM attribute WHERE attribute_name = 'Eye Colour'
),
BrownHairIds AS (
  SELECT attribute_value AS brown_hair_colour_id FROM hero_attribute ha
  WHERE ha.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM HairAttr) AND ha.attribute_value IN (
    SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Brown'
  )
), BrownHairedHeroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM hero_attribute ha
  WHERE ha.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM HairAttr) AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT brown_hair_colour_id FROM BrownHairIds)
), 
BrownHairEyeColours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ha.attribute_value AS eye_colour_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  WHERE ha.hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM BrownHairedHeroes) AND ha.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM EyeAttr)
), 
NonBrownHairEyeCount AS (
  SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(DISTINCT ha.hero_id) AS count_non_brown
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN colour c ON ha.attribute_value = c.id
  WHERE ha.attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM EyeAttr)
    AND ha.attribute_value IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM BrownHairEyeColours)
    AND ha.hero_id IN (
      SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute
      WHERE attribute_id = (SELECT id FROM HairAttr) AND attribute_value != (SELECT brown_hair_colour_id FROM BrownHairIds)
    )
  GROUP BY c.colour
)
SELECT eye_colour, count_non_brown
FROM NonBrownHairEyeCount
ORDER BY count_non_brown DESC, eye_colour ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH PatientsAbove55 AS (

    p.ID,
    p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE DATE('2026-10-09') >= DATE(p.Birthday, '+55 years')
),
AbnormalPTPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.PT >= 14 AND DATE(l.Date) <= DATE('2026-10-09')

EligiblePatients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM PatientsAbove55 p
  JOIN AbnormalPTPatients a ON p.ID = a.ID
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS FemalePercentage
FROM EligiblePatients;

WITH PatientsWithAbnormalSSA AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0', '') AND SSA IS NOT NULL
),
OutpatientPatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = '-'
),
EligiblePatients AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM PatientsWithAbnormalSSA p
  JOIN OutpatientPatients o ON p.ID = o.ID
),
MaxAntiRNPTiter AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(CAST(RNP AS FLOAT)) AS max_titer
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND RNP != ''
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING ID IN (SELECT ID FROM EligiblePatients)
),
MaxOverallRNPTiter AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_titer) AS max_titer_overall
  FROM MaxAntiRNPTiter
)
SELECT m.ID, m.max_titer AS anti_RNP_titer
FROM MaxAntiRNPTiter m
JOIN MaxOverallRNPTiter mo ON m.max_titer = mo.max_titer_overall;

WITH DiagnosedPatients AS (
  SELECT
    Patient.ID AS patient_id
  FROM
    Patient
  JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
  WHERE
    Examination.Diagnosis IN ('RA', 'SJS')
  GROUP BY
    Patient.ID
  HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT Examination.Diagnosis) = 2
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Examination.Diagnosis NOT IN ('RA', 'SJS') THEN 1 END) = 0
),
PlateletResults AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN PLT > 100 AND PLT < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_platelet
  FROM
    Laboratory
  GROUP BY
    ID
)

SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.has_normal_platelet = 1 THEN 1 END) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.has_normal_platelet = 0 OR pr.has_normal_platelet IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS patients_without_normal_platelet
FROM
  DiagnosedPatients dp
  LEFT JOIN PlateletResults pr ON dp.patient_id = pr.patient_id;

WITH Female_SLE_Patients AS (

),
SLE_Examinations AS (
  SELECT e.ID, e.\"Examination Date\", e.Diagnosis, p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON 1=1
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
    AND p.ID = e.ID
    AND p.SEX = 'F'
),
SLE_Lab_Records AS (
  SELECT l.TP
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM SLE_Examinations)
    AND l.TP > 8.5
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TP - 8.5), 3) AS avg_deviation
FROM SLE_Lab_Records;

)

single_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom_bond_types
    GROUP BY atom_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
single_only_atoms_with_element AS (
    SELECT a.element, s.atom_id
    FROM single_bond_atoms s
    JOIN atom a ON s.atom_id = a.atom_id
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM single_only_atoms_with_element
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH TripleBondElements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
)

SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM TripleBondElements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;

WITH TripleBondElements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
),
ElementCounts AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM TripleBondElements
  GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element AS element_symbol, molecule_count
FROM ElementCounts
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC
LIMIT 1000

WITH atoms_in_TR397 AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397'
),
bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397')
  UNION
  SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = 'TR397')
),
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
  FROM atoms_in_TR397 a
  JOIN bond_atoms ba ON a.atom_id = ba.atom_id
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS num_atoms_in_bond
FROM bonded_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
